askInstall: iOS Studio isn't installed yet. Install it now?
askDetail:
It changes only files in your home folder:
• copies iOS Studio to ~/.local/share/omarchy-ios-studio
• adds an app launcher entry, an icon and the ~/.local/bin/ios-studio command
• adds an Omarchy theme hook, so the window follows your theme
• adds a marked rule to ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua that keeps the window opaque, and reloads Hyprland (a backup is kept; Settings can remove it)
• makes its settings, state and cache folders
No system packages and no timers. Then Setup opens, which installs the iOS tools.
installingDetail: Copying iOS Studio and adding it to the app launcher.
